texto.@es: Los causativos con sufijo son verbos léxicos y no siempre predecibles: 입다→입히다. -게 하다 es una construcción productiva; el contexto indica si se obliga o se permite.
texto.@en: The causes with suffix are lexic verbs and not always predictable: 입다 → 입히다. -게 하다 is a productive construction; the context indicates whether it is forced or allowed.
